name: Chichigami Rio
source:
The older twin sister. The opposite of her younger sister Kana. She is free-spirited and longs to see the world outside the mansion. She keeps these sentiments to herself and away from Kana.

She is a cheerful girl full of positivity but sometimes she will overthink things making her feel alone. In contrast to her outgoing and energetic attitude, she shows a surprisingly girly side.

There are also times when she just can't be honest with her sister but this is just to hide her embarrassment.

Nipple Size: L(5.6cm)
Areola color: Shinonome-iro (yellowish pink)
